title: Finance Transaction APIs: New Fee & Tax Properties for Growth Package and Auto-Post Shoppable Video
content:
## Summary Three Finance transaction APIs — **Get Transactions by Order**, **Get Transactions by Statement**, and **Get Unsettled Transactions** — add **8 new response properties** under the existing `fee_tax_breakdown.fee` and `fee_tax_breakdown.tax` objects. Four properties report the fee and sales tax charged for the three new **Smart Promotion Growth Packages** (New Customer / Store GMV / Target Product GMV), and four report the commission fee and sales tax for orders attributed to **AI-generated, auto-post shoppable videos**. All properties are purely additive — no existing field is removed, renamed or re-typed, and there is no request parameter change on any of the three APIs. ## Impact | Item | Detail | | --- | --- | | **Impacted endpoints** | Response only (new fields), no request change:

* Get Transactions by Order
* Get Transactions by Statement
* Get Unsettled Transactions | | **Impacted version(s)** | `202501` (Get Transactions by Order, Get Transactions by Statement), `202507` (Get Unsettled Transactions) | | **Impacted market(s)** | Growth Package **fee** fields (`*_growth_package_fee`): **US / JP / EU / UK**.
Growth Package **tax** fields (`*_tax` / `*_sales_tax`): **US only** for now | | **Seller type** | L2L and cross-border (CB) sellers enrolled in the corresponding Smart Promotion Growth Package. | | **Permission scope** | No new permission scope. Apps already authorized for the existing Finance/transaction scopes continue to work without re-authorization. | | **Effective date** | Already live in the response schema, aligned with the Growth Package feature rollout (target: end of August 2026 per the product roadmap). Values are `"0"` for shops/orders not enrolled in or not attributed to the corresponding program. | | **Compatibility** | **Non-breaking**. Only 8 new response properties are added under `fee_tax_breakdown.fee` / `fee_tax_breakdown.tax`; no existing field, type or required-ness changes. | ## Field-level diff | Field | Category | Location | Old | New | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `new_customer_growth_package_fee` | Fee | `fee_tax_breakdown.fee` | Not returned | `string` amount, additive | | `store_gmv_growth_package_fee` | Fee | `fee_tax_breakdown.fee` | Not returned | `string` amount, additive | | `target_product_gmv_growth_package_fee` | Fee | `fee_tax_breakdown.fee` | Not returned | `string` amount, additive | | `auto_post_shoppable_video_commission_fee` | Fee | `fee_tax_breakdown.fee` | Not returned | `string` amount, additive | | `new_customer_growth_package_fee_tax` | Tax | `fee_tax_breakdown.tax` | Not returned | `string` amount, additive | | `store_gmv_growth_package_fee_sales_tax` | Tax | `fee_tax_breakdown.tax` | Not returned | `string` amount, additive | | `target_product_gmv_growth_package_tax` | Tax | `fee_tax_breakdown.tax` | Not returned | `string` amount, additive | | `auto_post_shoppable_video_sales_tax` | Tax | `fee_tax_breakdown.tax` | Not returned | `string` amount, additive | ## Field definition ### Growth Package fee & tax These three fees correspond to TikTok Shop's Smart Promotion **Growth Package** add-ons: sellers can additionally enroll in one or more growth packages on top of the base Smart Promotion package, and TikTok Shop's algorithm allocates subsidies toward the seller's chosen objective. The fee is charged based on `platform discount (co-funded label) × seller-borne percentage`, and covers **product-price subsidies only** — shipping subsidies are excluded. * `new_customer_growth_package_fee` — fee for discounts funded through the New Customer Growth Package, used to attract new customers to the shop. * `store_gmv_growth_package_fee` — fee for discounts funded through the Store GMV Growth Package, used to grow store-wide sales. * `target_product_gmv_growth_package_fee` — fee for discounts funded through the Target Product GMV Growth Package, scoped to seller-selected products. * `new_customer_growth_package_fee_tax` / `store_gmv_growth_package_fee_sales_tax` / `target_product_gmv_growth_package_tax` — the sales tax charged on the corresponding growth package fee above. Currently populated for **US** sellers; for EU/UK/JP the tax is already netted into the fee amount, so these three tax fields return `"0"` there. ### Auto-post shoppable video * `auto_post_shoppable_video_commission_fee` — the commission fee charged to the seller for orders attributed to AI-generated, auto-post shoppable videos. * `auto_post_shoppable_video_sales_tax` — the sales tax applied to the auto-post shoppable video commission fee above. ## Samples Response sample — Get Transactions by Statement (`fee_tax_breakdown`, relevant fields only): ```JSON { "code": 0, "data": { "transactions": [ { "fee_tax_amount": "-8", "fee_tax_breakdown": { "fee": { "new_customer_growth_package_fee": "-3", "store_gmv_growth_package_fee": "-2", "target_product_gmv_growth_package_fee": "0", "auto_post_shoppable_video_commission_fee": "-1" }, "tax": { "new_customer_growth_package_fee_tax": "-0.3", "store_gmv_growth_package_fee_sales_tax": "-0.2", "target_product_gmv_growth_package_tax": "0", "auto_post_shoppable_video_sales_tax": "-0.1" } } } ] }, "message": "Success" } ``` Get Transactions by Order and Get Unsettled Transactions return the same `fee_tax_breakdown.fee` / `.tax` shape, nested under `data.sku_transactions[]` and `data.transactions[]` respectively. ## Is this a breaking change? **No — this is a non-breaking, additive change.** * All 8 fields are new **response** properties only; there is no request-side change to any of the three APIs. * No existing field is removed, renamed or re-typed, and no default value or existing behavior changes. * No new permission scope is introduced, so no re-authorization is required. ## Developer action items * **If you don't offer or track Growth Packages / auto-post shoppable video**: no action is required. The 8 new fields simply return `"0"` and your existing integration keeps working unchanged. * **If you want to reconcile Growth Package spend**: read `fee_tax_breakdown.fee.new_customer_growth_package_fee` / `store_gmv_growth_package_fee` / `target_product_gmv_growth_package_fee` and the matching `*_tax` / `*_sales_tax` fields into your cost/P&L reporting. * **If you track auto-post shoppable video commission**: read `fee_tax_breakdown.fee.auto_post_shoppable_video_commission_fee` and `fee_tax_breakdown.tax.auto_post_shoppable_video_sales_tax`. * **If your app has a strict response schema**: add these 8 fields to your `fee_tax_breakdown.fee` / `.tax` models as optional string amounts, and tolerate additional unknown fields TikTok Shop may add in the future. * No API version upgrade or re-declaration is required — keep calling the existing `202501` / `202507` endpoints as before. ## References * [Get Transactions by Order](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-transactions-by-order) * [Get Transactions by Statement](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-transactions-by-statement) * [Get Unsettled Transactions](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-unsettled-transactions) * [Finance API overview](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/finance-api-overview)
